content.text: Ka capa, ka lawk hah ngâi nateh,
kaie kâpoelawknaw e hah na lungthung vah na pâkuem pawiteh,
Lungangnae koe lah na hnâpakeng nateh,
na thai panuek nahanelah na lungthin na poe pawiteh,
Kapek thai nahanelah na kaw teh,
thaipanueknae tawn hanelah na hram pawiteh,
ngun patetlah na tawng teh,
hro e hno patetlah na tawng pawiteh,
BAWIPA takinae na panue vaiteh,
Cathut panuenae hah na hmu han.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, BAWIPA ni lungangnae a poe teh,
a pahni hoi panuenae hoi thaipanueknae hah ouk a tâco sak.
Tamikalannaw hanelah lungangnae
katang hah a pâkhueng pouh teh,
kalan lah kacetnaw hanelah bahling lah ao.
Kângingnae lam hah a ring teh,
a tamikathoungnaw e lamthung hah a ngue pouh.
Hottelahoi, kângingnae hoi lannae na thaipanuek vaiteh,
ngaima tawnhoehnae hoi kahawi e lamthung hai na panue han.
Na lungthin dawk lungangnae a kâen toteh,
panuenae teh, na hringnae kanawm sakkung lah ao han.
Poukpanueknae ni na ngue vaiteh,
thaipanueknae ni na ring han.
Tamikathoutnaw e lamthung dawk hoi na rungngang han.
Lawk longkawi lah ka dei e,
Lannae lamthung ka pahnawt niteh,
hmonae lamthung dawn hanelah ka cet e,
thoenae saknae dawk lungkahawi e,
tamikathout lanhoehnae dawk a lungkahawi e,
Lam longkawi ka dawn niteh,
a lamthung dawk yuemkamcu hoeh e,
Kahlong lae napui hoi
pasawtpanep lawk ka hno e,
A naw nah hui ka cettakhai niteh,
a Cathut lawkkam kapahnimnaw koehoi
nang hah na rungngang han.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, ahnie im ni duenae koe lah a hrawi teh,
ahnie lam ni tamikadoutnaw koelah a pâtam.
Ahni koe kacetnaw teh ban boihoeh toe.
Hringnae lam hah dawn boi awh hoeh toe.
Nang teh tamikahawinaw e lamthung na dawn vaiteh,
lannae lamthung pou na dawn thai nahane doeh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, tamikalan teh ram dawk kho a sak vaiteh,
tami kakuep teh hawvah pou ao han.
Hatei, tamikathout teh talai van hoi takhoe lah awm vaiteh,
yuemkamcu hoeh naw hah phawk lah ao awh han.
